name: Spectra Router arbitrary call
summary: The Router's command executor did not validate the target/parameters of the commands it dispatched, so the attacker crafted a transferFrom-style call and pulled 188,013 asdCRV out of wallets that had approved the router.
notes: The proxy's sole pre-exploit Upgraded event selected the defect-bearing implementation during proxy deployment.
Gross loss in this exploit transaction. The asdCRV amount is the exact Transfer emitted by the token; the USD value is the contemporaneous amount reported by Verichains.
The USD value is a contemporaneous reported valuation; no independent incident-time price series was reconstructed.
